title: Implement flattenRoot() API
description: Create a function in @syncupsuite/tokens that flattens a DTCGRoot into a flat token list that adapters consume. Each FlatToken has: path, value, type, description, extensions. References resolved to final values.
acceptance_criteria: flattenRoot(tokens: DTCGRoot): FlatToken[] exported from tokens package
Each FlatToken has: path, value, type, description, extensions
Unit tests for all token types (color, dimension, fontFamily)

evidence.context: Adapter isolation requires flat token input format
